title: Q-6: Pilot sign-up flow
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/Q-6.json::Status:\*\* closed
**Status:** closed

Migrated from GitHub issue 6 (Issues are off on the code repository; this file is the record).

Replace the mailto link on ultrastable.io/pilot with a form that stores requests (D1) and sends a confirmation; tap-based, no free text beyond an email address.

size: M

**Closing probe:** POST to the pilot form stores a row in D1 and a confirmation email is delivered in a test run.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 222.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
